Parties ## 1.1 Service Provider Stratagem Olympus LLP, a limited liability partnership incorporated under the laws of India, having LLPIN ACL-0847, PAN AFMFS3993M, and registered office at Office No. 40, 7th Floor, Tardeo A.C. Market Building, Tardeo Road, Tardeo, Tulsiwadi, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400034, India, represented by its authorised signatory Vaibhav Bharat Kuvadia, Designated Partner; hereinafter referred to as "Stratagem Olympus" or "Service Provider". ## 1.2 Client Puretronics India Private Limited, a private limited company incorporated under the laws of India, having CIN U31909MH2023PTC397745, PAN AANCP5368E, GSTIN 27AANCP5368E1Z1, and registered office at VIRWANI INDL, A-37, 1st Floor, W.E. Highway, Goregaon (E), Mumbai, Maharashtra 400063, India, represented by its authorised signatory Aakash Sharad Goyal, Director; hereinafter referred to as "Puretronics" or "Client". Stratagem Olympus and Puretronics are individually referred to as a "Party" and collectively as the "Parties". # 2. Background 2.1 Puretronics has engaged Stratagem Olympus for a pilot project focused on Puretronics' Wire & Cable Industry Products. 2.2 The engagement is structured as a Custom Funnel Build + Monthly Demand Activation Pilot Project. 2.3 The engagement has two parts:
**Part** **Component** **Purpose**
Part I One-Time Custom Funnel Build Build the Wire & Cable Industry-focused funnel and campaign foundation
Part II Monthly Demand Activation Retainer Run monthly technical content, LinkedIn outreach, and cold email activation support
2.4 The Services are limited to the products and variants listed in Annexure A — Covered Wire & Cable Products and Variants. # 3. Term 3.1 The pilot project duration shall be from 15 July 2026 to 31 December 2027. 3.2 The One-Time Custom Funnel Build period shall be July 2026 and August 2026. 3.3 The Monthly Demand Activation Retainer period shall be from September 2026 to December 2027, being 16 months. 3.4 Timelines are subject to timely payment, Client inputs, approvals, product information, access credentials, additional quality work provided by the Service Provider, and technical validation. # 4. Scope of Services ## 4.1 Part I — One-Time Custom Funnel Build Stratagem Olympus shall build the Wire & Cable Industry-focused funnel and campaign foundation for the Covered Products listed in Annexure A. ## 4.2 Part II — Monthly Demand Activation Retainer From September 2026 to December 2027, Stratagem Olympus shall provide monthly demand activation services as described in Annexure B. The monthly retainer shall include: (1) Technical Content Production; (2) LinkedIn Outreach; (3) Cold Email Outreach / Support Layer. # 5. Fees and Payment Terms ## 5.1 One-Time Build Fee The one-time fee for Part I shall be INR 5,50,000.
**Milestone** **%** **Amount** **Timing**
Advance 60% INR 3,30,000 Payable upon execution of this Agreement
Balance 40% INR 2,20,000 Payable by 31 August 2026, Go-Live, or full completion of the one-time build, whichever occurs earlier
5.1.1 Stratagem Olympus shall not be required to commence work until the advance payment is received. 5.1.2 Delay in payment of the advance may shift project timelines without affecting Puretronics' payment obligations. 5.1.3 The balance payment shall become payable by 31 August 2026, Go-Live, or full completion of the one-time build, whichever occurs earlier. 5.1.4 If Go-Live or completion is delayed due to delay in Client approvals, product information, technical validation, access, feedback, or other Client-side dependencies, the balance payment shall still become payable by 31 August 2026. 5.1.6 The Client shall not be liable to make the final payment unless and until the Services have been fully completed in accordance with the agreed scope, deliverables, and quality standards under this Agreement; provided that this Clause shall not apply where completion is delayed by Client-side dependencies as described in Clause 5.1.4, in which case the balance shall remain payable in accordance with Clause 5.1.4. ## 5.2 Monthly Retainer Fee The monthly retainer for Part II shall be INR 65,000 per month. The retainer shall apply from September 2026 to December 2027, being 16 months.
**Component** **Amount (INR)**
Monthly Retainer INR 65,000 per month
Total Retainer Value for 16 months INR 10,40,000
Total Project Value (payment for Part I & Part II), excluding applicable taxes INR 15,90,000
## 5.3 Monthly Payment Window The monthly retainer shall be payable between the 15th and 20th day of every month, for the same month. Example: The retainer for January 2027 shall be payable between 15 January 2027 and 20 January 2027. ## 5.4 Taxes Each invoice raised by Stratagem Olympus shall comprise the service fee and the applicable GST thereon. GST and any other applicable taxes, duties, levies, or statutory charges shall be charged on the service fees as applicable at the time of issuing the relevant invoice and shall be payable by the Client together with the service fee under the relevant invoice, in accordance with the payment terms of this Agreement. Stratagem Olympus shall report each such invoice in its GST returns within the prescribed timelines so that the corresponding input tax credit is reflected in the Client's GST portal. ## 5.5 Late Payment and Suspension 5.5.1 If any undisputed invoice remains unpaid beyond the due date, a grace period of fifteen (15) days shall be provided to the Client. If the payment is not received within such grace period, Stratagem Olympus may suspend services until payment is received. 5.5.2 Suspension for non-payment shall not reduce or waive the fees payable by Puretronics. 5.5.3 Outstanding dues shall survive expiry or termination of this Agreement. 5.5.4 In the event of any delay in the posting, acknowledgment, or reflection of deliverables on the Client's portal due to reasons attributable to the Client, including without limitation delays in approvals, inputs, access, or feedback, the payment timelines shall also be deemed automatically extended to the extent of such delay, provided that any such extension shall not exceed seven (7) days in the aggregate per affected payment. # 6. Client Responsibilities Puretronics shall provide timely: > 1. final product and variant list; 2. product specifications, datasheets, brochures, and images; 3. technical documents and application notes; 4. approval of product, technical, performance, and compliance claims; 5. brand assets; 6. domain, CRM, LinkedIn, email, or other access where required; 7. campaign feedback and approvals; 8. stakeholder availability and internal decisions. Puretronics shall be responsible for the accuracy and approval of all product claims, technical claims, performance claims, compliance claims, specifications, and materials provided or approved by it. Delays in Client inputs, approvals, access, or validation may affect timelines and monthly output without breach by Stratagem Olympus. However, it is agreed between the parties that the Service Provider shall give the Client an approval timeline of 7 days. # 7. Review and Approval 7.1 Stratagem Olympus shall submit drafts, assets, or deliverables for Puretronics' review where applicable. 7.2 Puretronics shall provide consolidated feedback within 7 (seven) business days. 7.3 If feedback is not received within the review period, the relevant deliverable may be treated as accepted for operational purposes, or timelines may be extended accordingly. 7.4 Revisions shall be reasonable and within the agreed scope. 7.5 Technical and product claim approval shall remain Puretronics' responsibility. # 8. Scope Control and Change Requests 8.1 The Services are limited to the Covered Products listed in Annexure A. 8.2 Any product, variant, category, business line, geography, language, campaign, page, integration, dashboard, automation, sales collateral, paid advertising activity, or outreach channel not expressly included shall be treated as excluded as provided in Annexure D. 8.3 Product variants may be grouped logically and shall not automatically create separate standalone pages, campaigns, forms, automations, or assets. 8.4 Any additional work shall require written approval covering scope, fees, and timeline impact. 8.5 Informal calls, WhatsApp messages, emails, or meetings shall not expand the scope unless confirmed in writing by Stratagem Olympus. # 9. Third-Party Tools and Platforms 9.1 The Services may involve third-party platforms such as LinkedIn, cold emailing platform, domains, hosting, CRM systems, analytics tools, automation tools, databases, and related software. 9.2 Third-party software and tool costs are included in the Service fees. Procurement of domains, mailboxes, and the prospects database, including list building, enrichment, verification, paid databases, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator, is excluded and shall be borne by Puretronics. 9.3 Stratagem Olympus shall not be responsible for platform outages, policy changes, account limitations, pricing changes, deliverability issues, account restrictions, or third-party technical failures. 9.4 Stratagem Olympus may pace, pause, or adjust outreach or campaign activity where required to protect account health, platform compliance, deliverability, or campaign quality. # 10. Performance Objective and No Guarantee 10.1 The Parties acknowledge that Stratagem Olympus shall work towards a dialogue initiation benchmark of approximately 15% to 20% of the total prospects outreached over a reasonable campaign period. This benchmark is a non-binding quality objective and does not constitute a committed quantity of leads, enquiries, or outcomes. 10.2 This benchmark shall not be treated as a guarantee, assured conversion rate, minimum service level, refund basis, penalty basis, or non-payment basis. Stratagem Olympus shall use reasonable commercial efforts towards it and shall perform the Services in a professional and diligent manner; such efforts shall not create any payment, refund, penalty, or set-off obligation tied to results. 10.3 Dialogue initiation may include shown interest in the products mentioned in “Annexure-A”, queried for the details in the products mentioned in “Annexure-A” or shared there details to know in respect of products mentioned in “Annexure-A” # 11. Intellectual Property 11.1 Puretronics shall continue to own its pre-existing materials, including trademarks, logos, product data, technical documents, images, brochures, and proprietary information. 11.2 Stratagem Olympus shall continue to own its pre-existing frameworks, templates, methods, systems, processes, know-how, and internal working logic. 11.3 Upon full payment, Puretronics shall receive the right to use the final approved buyer-facing deliverables created specifically for Puretronics under this Agreement. 11.4 Stratagem Olympus shall retain ownership of its underlying methods, reusable structures, templates, internal systems, and know-how. 11.5 Third-party assets shall remain subject to third-party terms. # 12. Confidentiality and Data Handling 12.1 Each Party shall keep confidential all non-public commercial, technical, strategic, product, campaign, customer, prospect, pricing, credential, and business information received from the other Party. 12.2 Confidentiality obligations shall not apply to information that is public, already known, independently developed, lawfully received from a third party, or legally required to be disclosed. 12.3 Puretronics shall be responsible for ensuring that any customer, prospect, or business contact data supplied by it is lawfully obtained and authorised for the intended use. 12.4 Stratagem Olympus shall handle campaign and business contact data reasonably and only for the purposes of providing the Services. 12.5 Where personal data is processed under this Agreement, Puretronics shall act as the Data Fiduciary / controller of such data, and Stratagem Olympus shall process such data only for providing the Services. Puretronics shall be responsible for required notices, consents, lawful basis, and instructions relating to such data. Stratagem Olympus shall apply reasonable security safeguards and, on expiry or termination, delete or return campaign data on written request, subject to legal, archival, or operational retention requirements. # 13. Liability and Indemnity 13.1 The Puretronics acknowledges that Stratagem Olympus does not guarantee any specific number of leads, meetings, enquiries, sales, purchase orders, revenue, or other commercial outcomes. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Stratagem Olympus shall perform the Services in accordance with the agreed scope, timelines, and service deliverables set out in this Agreement. 13.2 To the extent permitted by law, Stratagem Olympus' aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the total fees actually paid by Puretronics to Stratagem Olympus during the three (3) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim. 13.3 Puretronics warrants that all prospect, contact, and recipient data provided or approved by it has been lawfully obtained with a valid legal basis and/or consent, as applicable, for B2B outreach, including any cross-border recipients, and complies with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and any applicable foreign anti-spam and data-protection laws. Puretronics shall indemnify and hold Stratagem Olympus harmless against any third-party claim, regulatory action, or penalty arising from data provided, approved, or authorised by Puretronics for outreach. 13.4 Stratagem Olympus shall indemnify Puretronics against third-party claims that deliverables created specifically for Puretronics under this Agreement infringe that third party's intellectual property rights, excluding claims arising from Client-provided materials, Client modifications, or Client-directed content. This indemnity shall be Puretronics' sole and exclusive remedy for intellectual-property infringement. # 14. Suspension and Termination 14.1 Stratagem Olympus may suspend services after giving 15 days notice for overdue payment, delayed approvals, lack of inputs, lack of access, out-of-scope demands, platform risk, legal risk, or account-health concerns. 14.2 Either Party may terminate this Agreement for material breach if the breach is not cured within 30 days of written notice. 14.3 Non-payment of undisputed dues shall be treated as material breach. 14.4 Upon termination, Puretronics shall pay all undisputed outstanding amounts and fees for work completed up to the effective date of termination. 14.5 Advance payments and fees for completed work shall not be refundable. 14.6 Payment, confidentiality, intellectual property, liability, indemnity, and dispute resolution clauses shall survive expiry or termination. 14.7 The Monthly Demand Activation Retainer represents a committed engagement for the period September 2026 to December 2027. If either Party terminates the Retainer before 31 December 2027 for convenience — that is, other than for the other Party's uncured material breach (or, in the case of Puretronics, non-payment of undisputed dues) — the terminating Party shall pay the other an early-termination charge equal to two months' retainer, i.e. INR 1,30,000, in addition to all amounts due up to the effective date of termination. Where Stratagem Olympus is the terminating Party, it shall additionally complete the committed deliverables for the then-current paid month, refund any pre-paid but unearned retainer fees, and provide reasonable transition assistance. # 15. General Terms 15.1 The Parties are independent contractors. 15.2 Neither Party may assign or transfer this Agreement, or its rights and obligations under this Agreement, without the prior written consent of the other Party. 15.3 Stratagem Olympus may engage employees, consultants, freelancers, contractors, agencies, vendors, or other third-party service providers for the purpose of delivering the Services under this Agreement, provided Stratagem Olympus remains responsible for overall service delivery to Puretronics under this Agreement. 15.4 Puretronics shall not assign, transfer, delegate, or withhold its payment obligations, approval responsibilities, or Client-side responsibilities under this Agreement without Stratagem Olympus' prior written consent. 15.5 Force Majeure. Neither Party shall be liable for any delay or failure in performance caused by events beyond its reasonable control, including natural disasters, government actions, war, strikes, pandemics, or internet and telecommunications failures. Performance timelines and payment timeline shall be extended for the duration of such event, subject to a maximum extension of thirty (30) days. 15.6 Notices shall be sent to the following details, unless updated in writing:
**Party** **Email** **Address**
Stratagem Olympus LLP info@stratagemolympus.com Office No. 40, 7th Floor, Tardeo A.C. Market Building, Tardeo Road, Tardeo, Tulsiwadi, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400034
Puretronics India Private Limited ag@pureindia.net A-37, 1st Floor, Virwani Industrial Estate, W.E. Highway, Goregaon (E), Mumbai, Maharashtra 400063
15.7 If any provision is held invalid, the remaining provisions shall continue. 15.8 No waiver shall be valid unless in writing. 15.9 This Agreement and its annexures constitute the entire agreement between the Parties for this engagement. 15.10 Any amendment must be in writing and approved by both Parties. # 16. Governing Law and Dispute Resolution 16.1 This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India. 16.2 The Parties shall first attempt to resolve disputes through good-faith discussion between senior representatives. 16.3 If unresolved within 30 days, the dispute shall be referred to arbitration under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. 16.4 The arbitration shall be conducted by a sole arbitrator mutually appointed by the Parties. 16.5 The seat and venue of arbitration shall be Mumbai, Maharashtra. 16.6 The language of arbitration shall be English. 16.7 Subject to arbitration, courts at Mumbai, Maharashtra shall have exclusive jurisdiction. # Signatures

## Monthly Scope Conditions > 1. Monthly outputs are subject to timely inputs, approvals, account access, platform limits, data availability, and campaign feasibility. 2. Additional language versions.
